subject: FinPulse: post-demo quality alert — diffs & pin request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finpulse.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinPulse: post-demo quality alert — diffs & pin request

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum and address the QA items you flagged: 

What we saw
- During the demo you showed three examples where the responses changed after the model update on your trial instance (shorter completions, missing numeric extraction in example #2).
- You mentioned these regressions started happening after 2027-10-28 when the hosted runtime rolled a V2 kernel and switched the default quantized runtime for the 13B variant.

Our immediate plan
1) I attached an eval pack (eval_pack_finpulse_v1.zip) containing: prompt_set CSV, representative test cases, and a small diff_snippets.txt with side-by-side model outputs.
2) We recommend pinning your session to redwood-13b-stable@2027-10-26 while we triage — this avoids drift while we investigate.
3) We'll run a focused A/B run with the two variants and share token-level diff links by EOD.

Requested from FinPulse
- Can you confirm which environment (trial vs dedicated) and the HubSpot deal id to attach the ticket?
- Please drop 3–5 canonical prompts you care most about into the attached prompt set (I prefilled examples).

Attaching: eval_pack_finpulse_v1.zip (contains promptset + diff snippets)

I'll loop in Rishi and Monica from our stability team; Rishi will coordinate the emergency pin and engineering investigation.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

(Attachment: eval_pack_finpulse_v1.zip)

From: Elena Soto <elena@finpulse.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinPulse QA <qa@finpulse.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPulse: post-demo quality alert — diffs & pin request

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the pack. A few clarifications from our side: 
- This is on the trial account we spun up (trial.finpulse.redwood) — not on any dedicated cluster.
- The most critical failures are: (1) invoice total extraction now returns a sentence fragment instead of the numeric; (2) a business-logic prompt that previously favored conservative answers now hallucinates a missing policy clause.

I've uploaded two failing examples to the Drive folder you shared (filenames: failing_invoice_001.txt, hallucination_case_02.txt).

We're okay with pinning to your suggested snapshot if it buys time for triage. Please let us know the rollback/pin window and whether this will affect throughput for our trial.

Elena Soto
Head of Product, FinPulse
elena@finpulse.com

---
(Attachment references: failing_invoice_001.txt, hallucination_case_02.txt on Drive)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena@finpulse.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPulse: post-demo quality alert — diffs & pin request

Elena / Kimberly —

Thanks for the detail and the failing examples. Quick technical notes / proposed mitigation: 

What likely changed
- On 2027-10-28 we deployed an optimized attention kernel and switched the default to quantized path for the 13B family for better throughput at the cost of subtle fp -> int behavior differences in numeric extraction tasks.

Immediate actions (we can execute within hours)
- Emergency pin: Pin your trial to model identifier redwood-13b-stable@2027-10-26. That will route inference to the pre-update runtime until we finish triage. Impact: nominal — no throughput change, just a deterministic runtime selection.
- A/B diff: We'll run 200 representative prompts from your promptset (the one in promptset_finpulse_v1.csv) across redwood-13b-stable@2027-10-26 and redwood-13b-quant@2027-10-28, produce token-level diffs, and surface the top 10 regressions.
- Prompt-based guard: For extraction tasks we can temporarily add a regex post-processor to enforce numeric extraction as a stopgap while kernel changes are evaluated.

Recommended models/variants for evaluation
- redwood-13b-stable@2027-10-26 (pin target)
- redwood-13b-quant@2027-10-28 (current default; used for A/B)
- redwood-7b-highfidelity@2027-09-15 (alternative if quantized 13B proves brittle on extraction)

Deliverables and timeline
- By EOD: A/B run results (drive link), diff_snippets.txt with representative mismatches.
- 24–48 hours: deeper kernel regression triage with engineering, recommended patch or revert.

Please confirm: I will initiate the pin now pending your explicit approval to avoid changing any behavior without consent.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Stability Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

---
(Attachments: planned_eval_list.csv; will upload results to Drive)

Elena —

Approved to proceed with the emergency pin to redwood-13b-stable@2027-10-26. Rishi — please execute the pin and paste the pin ticket link here when done.

Elena — I'll also open a HubSpot ticket and attach the eval pack and drive links to the deal (FP-2027-042). Expect the A/B diff results in the next 6 hours; we'll prioritize extraction-related mismatches first.

If the regex post-processor is acceptable temporarily, we can bundle that into the trial config and roll it out in 1–2 hours to buy more time.

Thanks all — quick, pragmatic plan. Kimberly
